response.sql:
SELECT
  r.raceId,
  r.name AS race_name,
  AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12
GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Back-of-the-field” means results with classification order positionOrder of 12 or greater; laps values are numeric text, so they are cast to REAL for averaging.
